name: termux_env
cmd: sh /data/adb/lemon_kernel/lemon/dedup/run.sh termux_env export PREFIX=/data/data/com.termux/files/usr; export PATH=$PREFIX/bin:/system/bin; export LD_LIBRARY_PATH=$PREFIX/lib; export TMPDIR=$PREFIX/tmp; export HOME=/data/data/com.termux/files/home; cd $HOME; for c in clang gcc make cmake ninja python node git zip unzip curl openssl pkg dpkg; do printf '%-10s ' $c; if command -v $c >/dev/null 2>&1; then $c --version 2>&1 | head -n 1; else echo NOT_FOUND; fi; done
